description: You cannot restore mana, rage, or energy in any way, unless you are in a rested area.
name: Exhausted Wanderer

rules.description: You are unaffected by energize effects unless you are in a rested area. This includes mana potions, spells that restore mana / rage / energy, or talents that restore mana / rage / energy.
rules.name: No Energizes Unless Resting
